prompt: A watercolor illustration depicts a bustling construction site where soft pigments bleed into the paper texture. On the left, a worker in a yellow hard hat stands firmly with boots planted in mud. In the center, a foreman wearing blue overalls points decisively toward a stack of lumber. To the right, an engineer in a white shirt holds rolled blueprints tightly against their chest. A small brown dog sits patiently beside the engineer, its tail curled around its paws. The worker in the yellow hard hat is handing a heavy wrench to a colleague in green coveralls who stands just behind them. The foreman in blue overalls looks intently at the engineer in the white shirt, creating a visual line of communication across the scene. A large orange crane looms in the background, its arm extended high above the unfinished structure. There is no safety fencing visible in the foreground. The scene captures the raw energy of labor through loose brushstrokes and vibrant hues. The mud beneath the workers' feet is depicted with earthy browns and grays, contrasting with the bright safety gear. The sky above is a wash of pale blue, suggesting early morning light. Each figure is distinct, from the crumpled sleeves of the engineer to the sturdy posture of the worker. The dog adds a touch of warmth to the industrial setting. The interaction between the two workers emphasizes teamwork, while the gaze between the foreman and engineer highlights supervision. The absence of barriers gives the space an open, accessible feel despite the ongoing work.
